schemaMatches.quantity: physical page pool: depth (slice 0 merged/dynamic, slice 1 static) and visualization overdraw (slice 2), stored in R32_UINT
schemaMatches.units: depth as float32 bits; slice2 overdraw count

storage.arraySlices: 2 in final capture (runtime may be >=3 only when visualization slice is allocated)

transforms.name: initSlice0
transforms.expression: if static cached: slice0 = slice1; else slice0 = 0

mathTerms: depth is IEEE-754 float bit pattern stored in an R32_UINT resource; not a variance map
gaps: This is a depth shadow map, NOT a variance shadow map: the pool stores depth (asfloat) and receiver masks; no variance/moment pair is stored.
Final capture reports ArraySize=2, so only slices 0/1 exist; the slice-2 OverdrawCount field is optional and absent unless ArraySize>=3.

fields.name: Depth
fields.decode: slice 0: asfloat(word) = projected VSM clip-space depth; slice 1: static cached depth. Compare against the receiver projected Z (not a variance moment).

fields.name: OverdrawCount
fields.decode: slice 2: visualization overdraw count (not a depth)
